scope: Ten bounded drop-in modules, package tests, sample fixtures, package conformance test and integration documentation.
testCommands: for f in drop-in/*/test.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
knownLimitations: No platform adapter or registry integration is included.
Reduced-order solver and geometry modules are not industrially qualified.
HIL adapter attestation verifier must be implemented against a trusted hardware identity root.
Full acceptance mutation run exceeded available execution window; browser gate is unverified because Playwright is unavailable.
